title: Question for artists and AI generated variations of sprites
author: SquareWolfGames
selftext:
Hello, im a game dev. Ive been using AI to generate variations of existing sprites lately from assets packs. Basically Id like to eventually replace the generated arts with a real artist arts (since the icons I need don't exist) What do you think of this workflow?

I completly separate and document which arts are from artists, which are simply variations and which are completly constructed from ai usage.

The licenses on the assets packs Ive bought allow me to modify the sprites (as long as I credit and don't resell them)

Exemple image of my internal documentation:
